title: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun Travels to Nepal to Press for Intensified Search
detail: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun arrived in Kathmandu for a three-day visit, pledging to 'speed up search efforts for our missing nationals so that they can be rescued alive.' He planned to meet Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal, meet with families of the nine missing Koreans, encourage the Korea Disaster Relief Team on the ground, and discuss long-term reconstruction cooperation.

media.caption: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun arrives at Tribhuvan International Airport in Nepal

title: Nepal Army Bars On-Foot Search for Missing Koreans as 'Too Dangerous'
detail: The Nepal Army refused to permit an on-foot search by the Korea Disaster Relief Team in the Ramche area near the Upper Trishuli-1 site, roughly 2km from the base camp, citing near-90-degree mountainous terrain between the upper weir dam and the powerhouse. A Nepal Army commander said a foot search was too dangerous to authorize, forcing continued reliance on helicopters, thermal-imaging drones and ground teams elsewhere in the search zone.

media.caption: Nepal Army personnel conduct search operations near the Trishuli hydropower plant
